title: Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE): explanation and elaboration
coreEvidence: Authoritative reporting framework for observational design, bias, participants, variables, and statistical methods.

title: Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD)
coreEvidence: Reporting and appraisal requirements for prediction model development and validation.

title: TRIPOD+AI statement
coreEvidence: Current TRIPOD reporting guidance for clinical prediction models using regression or machine-learning methods; it replaces the 2015 checklist while retaining it as a foundational source.

title: CONSORT 2010 Statement: updated guidelines for reporting parallel group randomised trials
coreEvidence: Authoritative framework for randomised trial design and reporting.

title: Reporting recommendations for tumor marker prognostic studies (REMARK)
sourceName: Journal of the National Cancer Institute
coreEvidence: Design, analysis, and transparent reporting expectations for prognostic tumor marker studies.

title: Pseudoreplication in physiology: More means less
coreEvidence: Explains how treating non-independent observations as replicates inflates apparent sample size and invalidates inference.

title: Confronting false discoveries in single-cell differential expression
coreEvidence: Benchmarking shows that methods respecting biological replication, including pseudobulk approaches, better control false discoveries.

title: Controlling the false discovery rate: a practical and powerful approach to multiple testing
sourceName: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B
coreEvidence: Defines the false discovery rate and a procedure for controlling it across multiple hypotheses.

title: Multiple imputation for missing data in epidemiological and clinical research: potential and pitfalls
coreEvidence: Practical rationale, assumptions, and pitfalls for multiple imputation rather than complete-case analysis.

title: Regression Models and Life-Tables
sourceName: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B
coreEvidence: Foundational proportional hazards regression model for censored time-to-event data.

title: A proportional hazards model for the subdistribution of a competing risk
sourceName: Journal of the American Statistical Association
coreEvidence: Foundational subdistribution hazard model for cumulative incidence under competing risks.

title: Calibration: the Achilles heel of predictive analytics
coreEvidence: Explains calibration-in-the-large, calibration slope, and why discrimination alone is insufficient.

title: Decision curve analysis: a novel method for evaluating prediction models
coreEvidence: Introduces net benefit across threshold probabilities to assess clinical utility.

title: Internal validation of predictive models: efficiency of some procedures for logistic regression analysis
coreEvidence: Shows the role of resampling-based internal validation for estimating optimism.

title: Gene set enrichment analysis: A knowledge-based approach for interpreting genome-wide expression profiles
sourceName: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
coreEvidence: Foundational ranked-list gene-set enrichment method and its permutation framework.

title: Tackling the widespread and critical impact of batch effects in high-throughput data
coreEvidence: Describes origins, detection, and consequences of batch effects in high-throughput experiments.

title: A comparison of single-cell trajectory inference methods
coreEvidence: Benchmarks trajectory inference approaches and explains dependence on topology, features, and assumptions.

title: Inference and analysis of cell-cell communication using CellChat
coreEvidence: Defines a ligand-receptor expression-based framework; inferred communication remains a model-based hypothesis.

title: Spatially resolved transcriptomics adds a new dimension to genomics
coreEvidence: Reviews resolution, measurement, integration, and inference limits in spatial transcriptomics.

title: Clustering stability: an overview
coreEvidence: Defines stability-based checks for whether cluster solutions persist under perturbation.

title: Leakage in data mining: Formulation, detection, and avoidance
sourceName: ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data
coreEvidence: Formalizes information leakage and prevention through correct separation of training and evaluation operations.

title: A survey of best practices for RNA-seq data analysis
coreEvidence: Best-practice principles for design, QC, quantification, differential analysis, and interpretation in transcriptomics.

title: PROBAST: A Tool to Assess the Risk of Bias and Applicability of Prediction Model Studies
coreEvidence: Structured assessment of participants, predictors, outcomes, analysis, applicability, and risk of bias in prediction models.

title: The PRISMA 2020 statement: an updated guideline for reporting systematic reviews
coreEvidence: PRISMA 2020 provides a 27-item checklist and flow-diagram framework for transparent reporting of systematic reviews.

title: STARD 2015: an updated list of essential items for reporting diagnostic accuracy studies
coreEvidence: STARD specifies essential reporting items for diagnostic accuracy studies, including participant flow, index-test thresholds, and reference standards.

title: Causal diagrams for epidemiologic research
coreEvidence: Directed acyclic graphs encode causal assumptions and help distinguish confounders from colliders and mediators before model adjustment.

title: Using Big Data to Emulate a Target Trial When a Randomized Trial Is Not Available
coreEvidence: Explicitly specifying eligibility, treatment strategies, assignment, follow-up, outcomes, causal contrast, and analysis helps prevent design-time biases in observational causal analyses.

title: The meaning and use of the area under a receiver operating characteristic curve
coreEvidence: ROC AUC summarizes ranking discrimination across thresholds but does not establish calibration or clinical utility.

title: Moderated estimation of fold change and dispersion for RNA-seq data with DESeq2
coreEvidence: DESeq2 models count data with negative-binomial generalized linear models and shrinks dispersion and fold-change estimates to improve stability.

title: edgeR: a Bioconductor package for differential expression analysis of digital gene expression data
coreEvidence: edgeR uses negative-binomial models with empirical-Bayes dispersion estimation for replicated count experiments.

title: Camera: a competitive gene set test accounting for inter-gene correlation
coreEvidence: CAMERA adjusts competitive gene-set testing for inter-gene correlation, which otherwise inflates false positives.

title: Robust enumeration of cell subsets from tissue expression profiles
coreEvidence: CIBERSORT estimates relative cell-type fractions from bulk expression using a signature matrix; identifiability depends on reference quality and mixture assumptions.

title: Accounting for the Multiple Natures of Missing Values in Label-Free Quantitative Proteomics Data Sets to Compare Imputation Strategies
coreEvidence: Proteomics imputation should match the missingness mechanism and analysis stage rather than applying a single method indiscriminately.

title: Current best practices in single-cell RNA-seq analysis: a tutorial
coreEvidence: Single-cell workflows require explicit quality control, normalization, feature selection, dimensionality reduction, correction, annotation, and question-specific downstream analysis.

title: DoubletFinder: Doublet Detection in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data Using Artificial Nearest Neighbors
coreEvidence: DoubletFinder uses artificial nearest neighbors to flag likely doublets; heterotypic doublets are more detectable than homotypic ones.

title: SoupX removes ambient RNA contamination from droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing data
coreEvidence: Ambient cell-free RNA is ubiquitous in droplet data and can create misleading expression unless contamination is estimated and corrected.

title: Normalization and variance stabilization of single-cell RNA-seq data using regularized negative binomial regression
coreEvidence: Regularized negative-binomial regression can stabilize UMI count variance while reducing sequencing-depth effects without heuristic pseudocount transforms.

title: Benchmarking atlas-level data integration in single-cell genomics
coreEvidence: Integration methods trade batch removal against biological conservation; method choice should be benchmarked for the task and modality rather than inferred from visual mixing alone.

title: RNA velocity of single cells
coreEvidence: Spliced and unspliced transcript ratios can estimate short-term directional state change under model assumptions; velocity is not direct lineage tracing.

title: Delineating copy number and clonal substructure in human tumors from single-cell transcriptomes
coreEvidence: copyKAT infers broad copy-number structure from single-cell transcriptomes to separate likely aneuploid tumor cells from diploid cells; inference is not DNA-level confirmation.

title: Visualization and analysis of gene expression in tissue sections by spatial transcriptomics
coreEvidence: Spatial transcriptomics links positional barcodes to expression measurements, preserving tissue context while introducing spot-level mixture and resolution constraints.

title: Statistical analysis of spatial expression patterns for spatially resolved transcriptomic studies
coreEvidence: SPARK models spatial expression patterns with generalized linear spatial models while controlling false discoveries across genes.

title: MOFA+: a statistical framework for comprehensive integration of multi-modal single-cell data
coreEvidence: MOFA+ uses a latent-factor model to separate shared and modality-specific sources of variation across multi-omics views.

title: DIABLO: an integrative approach for identifying key molecular drivers from multi-omics assays
coreEvidence: DIABLO performs supervised multi-omics integration to select correlated features associated with a categorical outcome; validation must remain separated from supervised selection.

title: The Image Biomarker Standardization Initiative: Standardized Quantitative Radiomics for High-Throughput Image-based Phenotyping
coreEvidence: IBSI standardizes radiomics feature definitions and reference values to improve implementation reproducibility across software.

title: Minimum sample size for developing a multivariable prediction model: Part II — binary and time-to-event outcomes
coreEvidence: Prediction-model sample size should be justified from outcome frequency, candidate parameters, anticipated performance, and shrinkage—not a universal events-per-variable rule.

title: Minimum sample size calculations for external validation of a clinical prediction model with a time-to-event outcome
coreEvidence: External-evaluation sample size should target precision for calibration, discrimination, and net benefit rather than a fixed event count.

title: Best practices for single-cell analysis across modalities
coreEvidence: Cross-modality single-cell analysis should follow question-specific, benchmark-informed workflows and preserve modality-specific measurement assumptions.

title: Differential abundance testing on single-cell data using k-nearest neighbor graphs
coreEvidence: Milo tests differential abundance in overlapping graph neighborhoods, avoiding dependence on a single hard clustering while requiring sample-aware experimental design.
